servers.name: Cloudflare 1.1.1.1
servers.description: Fast public resolver with a strong privacy focus. Does not block anything, so it is a good neutral choice.

servers.name: Cloudflare 1.1.1.3 (Malware and Adult Content Blocking)
servers.description: Blocks malware, phishing and adult content. Useful for a family PC or a shared network.

servers.name: Cloudflare 1.1.1.2 (Malware Blocking)
servers.description: The same resolver, but it refuses domains known to host malware or phishing. Does not block adult content.
